seo_title: Contact ElectraSim — Get Help or Send Feedback
seo_description: Have a question, bug report, or feature suggestion? Contact the ElectraSim team via Facebook or our feedback form.
hero_heading: We'd Love to Hear From You
hero_sub: Bug report? Feature idea? Just want to say hello? Pick your preferred way to reach us below.

faqs.question: Is ElectraSim really free?
faqs.answer: Yes — 100% free, forever. No sign-up, no subscription, no ads. Just open the simulator and start building.

faqs.question: Does my circuit data get sent to a server?
faqs.answer: Simulation runs in your browser and circuits are stored locally. If you explicitly create a share link, its circuit payload stays in the URL fragment, which browsers do not send to our servers.

faqs.question: Can I use ElectraSim offline?
faqs.answer: Yes. After your first visit, ElectraSim installs as a PWA and works completely offline. No internet needed.

faqs.question: I found a bug — how do I report it?
faqs.answer: Use the Feedback Form above or message us on Facebook. Please include your browser name and version if possible.

faqs.question: Can I request a new component or feature?
faqs.answer: Absolutely — we'd love to hear what you need. Submit your idea via the feedback form and we'll consider it for a future release.
